description: This file is a Python script that queries the capabilities of the 'cuttlefish-*' packages, allowing users to check for support of specific functionalities such as 'capability_check', 'qemu_cli', and 'vsock'. It can output all capabilities or verify support for requested ones via command-line arguments.
